fee_details:
- First year fee: Rs.499
- From the second year onwards, the annual fee is Rs.499. This amount is waived if you charge more than Rs.1 Lakh in your card in a year.
joining_perks: Earn 2000 bonus reward points by spending Rs.2,000 or more within the first 60 days of card issuance.
reward_structure:
- 10% rewards on everyday purchases
- Earn 1X reward points for every Rs.100 spent on movie tickets, departmental stores, grocery, and dining spends.
- Earn 1 reward point for every Rs.150 spent for all other categories
key_highlights:
- A hassle-free credit card with a minimal fee.
- Renewal fee waiver for milestone spends
- Accelerated reward points on daily & one-day spend categories.
- Bonus reward points within 60 days of card set up.

benefits_features.Fuel benefits: Get 2% waiver on your fuel surcharge when you spend between Rs.500 and Rs.3,000 at any petrol station in India.
benefits_features.Dining benefits: Earn 1X reward points for every Rs.100 spent on movie tickets, departmental stores, grocery, and dining spends.
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: Renewal fee: Rs.499. It is waived if you spend more than 1 Lakh per year. The waiver is applicable from the second year onwards.

how_tos.How to Apply for SimplySAVE SBI Card Onl:
You can visit SBI Cards' official website to apply for SimplySAVE SBI credit cards online.
Alternatively, you can also apply for the card through BankBazaar.com, which might offer you with some active partner offers.
Steps to apply for SBI SimplySAVE Credit Card through bankbazaar.com:
Step 1: Go to the 'Check Eligibility' button on the page.
Step 2: Fill the required details to know your eligibility to apply for the card.
Step 3: Eligible applicant would be redirected to the online application page.
Step 4: Fill the online application form and click on 'Submit'.
Step 5: Upload and submit the required documents.
Upon successful submission of the application, you will receive an acknowledgement message on your registered mobile number with the Application ID. You can use the same to track your credit card application status.

miscellaneous:
The SimplySAVE SBI Card is accepted in more than 24 million outlets worldwide (including 2.25 lakh outlets in India).
With the balance transfer facility, outstanding dues from any bank's credit cards can be transferred to the SimplySAVE SBI Card at low interest and repaid in EMI.

faqs.What is the difference between SBI Simpl: While the SBI SimplySAVE Credit Card offers benefits on day-to-day spends such as dining, movies, grocery, and others; SimplyCLICK for online shopping. Most of the features and benefits are similar to the latter one even during online shopping.
faqs.Can my family members and I use the card: Your family members above the age of 18 years can apply for a credit card on which has similar features as that of your card.
faqs.Am I allowed to transfer outstanding due: Yes, you can use the SBI SimplySAVE Credit Card for transferring your outstanding balance from any other credit card.
faqs.Will the SBI SimplySAVE Credit Card be a: Yes, the SBI SimplySAVE Credit Card will be accepted overseas. Please note that this card will not be accepted in Nepal and Bhutan.
faqs.How do I redeem my reward points on my S: You can visit the reward points section on the SBI website and find methods online. Visit the SBI website to learn more about redeeming your reward points.
faqs.Will the SBI SimplySAVE credit card rewa: No, the reward points will not run on the SBI SimplySAVE card, and expire after two years.
